definitions.gloss: cake flour; soft wheat flour; all-purpose flour (low gluten)
definitions.explanation: A type of wheat flour with low protein (gluten) content, producing soft, tender textures. Used for cakes, cookies, tempura batter, and other recipes that require a light, non-chewy result.

notes:
Composed of {薄力|はくりき} (weak/low strength) + {粉|こ} (flour/powder). The name refers to the low gluten content — '{薄|はく}' meaning thin/weak and '{力|りき}' meaning strength.

USAGE:
One of the most common ingredients in Japanese cooking and baking. Essential for recipes that require a soft, tender texture rather than chewiness. Appears frequently in recipe instructions.
In Japanese supermarkets, {薄力粉|はくりきこ} is the most commonly sold type of flour, as it is used for the widest range of Japanese home cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄力粉|はくりきこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふるう: to sift cake flour
- {薄力粉|はくりきこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add cake flour
- {薄力粉|はくりきこ}200g: 200 grams of cake flour
